label: Diagram 8.4
caption: Diagram 8.4 Provisions for cavity barriers in double-skinned insulated roof sheeting
description: This is a cross-sectional diagram. The text 'See para 8.7' appears at the top left, and a green band running along the bottom carries the title 'Diagram 8.4 Provisions for cavity barriers in double-skinned insulated roof sheeting'. It contains two side-by-side sections of roof sheeting. The left, labelled 'Arrangement A' and 'Acceptable without cavity barriers', shows a corrugated top skin resting directly on a hatched green insulation layer above a flat bottom skin. The right, labelled 'Arrangement B' and 'Cavity barriers necessary', shows the same corrugated top skin, but set above the hatched insulation so that a gap is left between them, with a solid green vertical block rising from the insulation to the top skin beneath a trough of the top skin. On the right, two leader lines identify the 'Cavity barrier' and the 'Insulation'. Beneath both sections, running text reads: 'The insulation should make contact with both skins of sheeting. See also Diagram 5.2a regarding the need for fire-stopping where such roofs pass over the top of a compartment wall.'
